headline: 1 Industrials Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Ignore
summary: Industrials businesses quietly power the physical things we depend on, from cars and homes to e-commerce infrastructure. Unfortunately, this role also comes with a demand profile tethered to the ebbs and flows of the broader economy, and the industry is currently lagging as its six-month return of 1.2% has trailed the S&P 500’s 8.3% gain.
